c1: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris. It was completed in 1889 and stands on the Champ de Mars.
c2: Paris is the capital of France and its most populous city. The Seine flows through Paris.
c3: The Louvre museum in Paris holds the Mona Lisa. Visitors queue for the painting in Paris.
c4: Mount Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan. It sits south-west of Tokyo and is a dormant volcano.
c5: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and the largest metropolitan area in the world.
c6: The Great Barrier Reef lies off the coast of Queensland in Australia. It is the largest coral reef system.
c7: Canberra is the capital of Australia and was purpose-built as a capital city.
